Found by chance online
Very friendly staff
Price/quality ratio 🔝
Highly recommended
5 stars for me
Exceptional place for pet grooming, very friendly and welcoming, I highly recommend it to all of you, warm regards to the owner. Greetings from HARON.
Professionalism and friendliness. It was our first time and we will definitely be back.

I found this groomer online while searching for a place in Magliana to take my dog, Joy, a 9-year-old Cocker Spaniel, and I'm so happy with my choice! 🐶❤️
She was groomed to perfection, with great care and attention. The staff is very knowledgeable, professional, and empathetic; you can immediately see that they love animals and know how to treat them properly.
I live in Milan, and it's not always easy to find a trustworthy place in Rome, but I had a great time here. My dog ​​came out beautiful and, above all, happy.
Highly recommended! I'll definitely be back! 🥰🐾
Super super positive experience! Bugo thanks ❤️
Professionals..prepared excellent work..my little lion came out a real figurine..thanks
Every month I come from Viterbo to this toilet!!! 🔝 …
Impeccable service
Qualified and very kind staff. I tried many places before finding this one and it's the only one where I take my dog ​​now.

I took my dog ​​to be groomed at Trilly's House in Rome's Magliana area and was truly satisfied! The owner, Loredana, and her staff were kind and professional, taking great care of my dog, Luna. The result was fantastic: my dog ​​came home clean, smelling good, and with a super soft coat. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for quality grooming services.
Excellent and professional! Always a pleasure to come here!
Very good

I've been taking my two poodles for 4 years now, and they're always beautiful and spotless.
A welcoming place, with qualified, well-trained staff and everyone is incredibly kind. They take 100% care of our four-legged friends 💗💗💗 …

I brought my puppy here. He's very fearful, but from the first time he was welcomed with kindness and love by Loredana and the staff. In fact, he let us wash him without too many problems and now he comes back here more relaxed.
These are his clean paws after his appointment here.
The best in Rome!!!
As always, the welcome and friendliness are at home!!!

I've been a customer for years. I own three toy poodles.
I've tried many in Rome and finally found Loredana thanks to word of mouth. I found professionalism, expertise, reliability, cleanliness, and the deep love Loredana has for our four-legged friends, which is shared by our furry friends. I travel a long way to get to her, but it's worth it. Everything is visible from a large window. Highly recommended.
Loredana, Erica, and the entire staff are wonderful, professional, and knowledgeable. My Bill loves them. 🔝🔝🔝🔝 …
Very good professionals
by the top
Super qualified staff 💖 throughout Rome because they treat my Olimpia like a little princess. TOP …
Very good

Loredana is a blessing! There's no other way to put it.
​I've tried several places, but since I brought my dog ​​here, I've had it all figured out. Loredana has infinite patience (and my shepherd is no saint!) and you can tell she loves her job.
​The dog always comes out spotless, smells great, and—most importantly—relaxed. No stress. The quality of the products is high, and she's super careful not to hurt him.
​If you're in the Magliana area and are looking for a groomer where your friend is treated with love, you can't go wrong.
​Highly recommended, 5 stars!
They are very good, especially the owner who is very polite and friendly, very professional, we had a great time❤️
Fantastic
Very welcoming dog grooming... friendly and knowledgeable staff. I've been taking my dog ​​there for many years and have always had a great experience. Highly recommended, top notch!!!
Very good, courteous, competent, at excellent prices, highly recommended
Very good
Professional, kind, very punctual

Lory and her staff are top notch, friendly with customers and adorable with dogs... they stand out for their professionalism, kindness, and politeness.
I couldn't have asked for more for my dog ​​and myself, because I feel at home every time I go. Between their chatter and laughter, they make their human customers feel at ease, not just at home!
Highly recommended!!!
I've been bringing my Oliver since they opened, super satisfied
Qualified staff ❤️excellent service, my little one is always happy to be pampered by them
Very good
I've always had a good time

Kindness, professionalism, and availability
Always.
Thank you, Lory

I've known Loredana for years, and for the past two years, we've been taking our large dog, ARES, there. Loredana and the girls are fantastic, patient, sweet, and very professional.
ARES is a large breed, weighing 45 kg, yet they manage him with ease. Congratulations on your great professionalism. Thank you. Laura Giovannetti

Loredana is a fantastic person and treats all the animals as if they were her own. The staff is top-notch, all knowledgeable and extremely friendly. Perfect service, in my opinion the best in the area. Highly recommended!
Qualified and professional staff, very sweet and affectionate with their furry friends, my Zara never wants to leave 🤣🤣🤣 I highly recommend them …

I've been going every month for two years now, and my red dog is always treated as if he were their own dog. Qualified and understanding staff... kind and always smiling, ready to fulfill every request. It's truly a pleasure to come and bring your pet and watch him be pampered like this. I truly recommend it to everyone... reliable and precise every time.
Brave and very kind

I've been a customer of La Casa di Trilly for years and couldn't be more satisfied! The service is always impeccable, professional, and above all attentive to the animals' well-being. The environment is welcoming, clean, and thoughtfully designed to make our four-legged friends feel at home.

The staff is kind, competent, and demonstrates genuine love for every animal they take in. My puppy is always happy to return, a sign that he feels safe and pampered.

I highly recommend La Casa di Trilly to anyone looking for a reliable and loving place for their pet. It's much more than a boarding or grooming service: it's a second home!

I visited countless groomers before finding them.
They're excellent, competent, and very professional.
They do their job with love and passion for our four-legged friends.
My Billy loves them and is always so happy when he leaves.
I recommend them to everyone.

I took my dog ​​to the dog groomer last week and was very disappointed. They didn't show any professionalism; they returned the dog after 15 minutes still damp, and they didn't even trim his nails or clean his ears. I don't recommend it.

I brought my dogs to this groomer with high expectations. The first two times, the service was satisfactory, but after the third visit, the quality dropped. The work was done a bit too quickly, without the care I expected. Only after I got home did I notice that their nails hadn't been trimmed, their ears hadn't been cleaned, and the grooming hadn't been done properly. When I raised the issue, the response was that "they hadn't supervised the girls," but if there was no supervision, I think the least I could get was a refund. Unfortunately, I paid without receiving the service I expected, and for that reason, I can't recommend this place.
Very good and nice💪💪 …

I learned about Trilly's house from my aunt and I tried it and was very satisfied with the care and professionalism... I come from Rebbibia and pass through Rome to bring my furry friend here... she is very calm and lets everything be done, I recommend her to everyone...
Here you will find professionalism, courtesy, excellent value for money and lots and lots of sweetness with our furry friends ❤️ I highly recommend it!!!!
Great staff♥️

This is my first time bringing my pitbull-like Yago, at the recommendation of an acquaintance who is already a customer.
I had a great time!! The welcome and family atmosphere were fantastic, considering it was my first time.
The wash was very quick, and when I picked Yago up, he was not only very happy, but he smelled wonderful, and his fur was still incredibly soft, even after several days (of rain and being in the park). Another thoughtful touch was trimming the dewclaws on his hind legs, which were a bit long (I couldn't do it myself, but they were sticking out a bit. I didn't ask out of shyness, as it was my first time). The staff was cheerful, welcoming, and professional. I will definitely be back!
Empathy, friendliness, and sensitivity. The owners and all the wonderful staff take care of our furry treasures with all the love and professionalism possible. Highly recommended.
Tinker Bell's House is the best! That's a dachshund's word 🐾 …
Excellent at their job, number one professionals
Excellent, professional, and very friendly. The best dog groomer in Rome, without a doubt.
